sections.heading: Glossary term: Accretion
sections.body: Accretion is the process of an astrophysical object attracting additional matter, typically gas or dust, by its gravitational pull. Accretion happens in many different astronomical scenarios including (but not limited to): gas accreting onto a black hole, stars in binary systems accreting matter from their companion, young stars accreting gas from a disk of material surrounding them, and galaxies accreting stars from other galaxies.

sections.source_html:
Glossary term: Accretion

Description: Accretion is the process of an astrophysical object attracting additional matter, typically gas or dust, by its gravitational pull. Accretion happens in many different astronomical scenarios including (but not limited to): gas accreting onto a black hole, stars in binary systems accreting matter from their companion, young stars accreting gas from a disk of material surrounding them, and galaxies accreting stars from other galaxies.

Related Terms:

  • Active Galactic Nucleus
  • Binary Star
  • Black Hole
  • Protostar
  • Accretion Disk
  • Cataclysmic Variable


See this term in other languages

Term and definition status: This term and its definition have been approved by a research astronomer and a teacher

The OAE Multilingual Glossary is a project of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Education (OAE) in collaboration with the IAU Office of Astronomy Outreach (OAO). The terms and definitions were chosen, written and reviewed by a collective effort from the OAE, the OAE Centers and Nodes, the OAE National Astronomy Education Coordinators (NAECs) and other volunteers. You can find a full list of credits here. All glossary terms and their definitions are released under a Creative Commons CC BY-4.0 license and should be credited to "IAU OAE".

If you notice a factual error in this glossary definition then please get in touch.
sections.body_ru: Аккреция — это процесс, при котором астрофизический объект притягивает дополнительное вещество, обычно газ или пыль, посредством своей гравитационной силы. Аккреция происходит в самых разных астрономических условиях. Примеры включают аккрецию газа на черную дыру, перетекание вещества со звезды-компаньона на другую звезду в двойной системе, аккрецию газа молодыми звездами из окружающего их диска вещества и захват галактиками звезд из других галактик. Этот перечень не исчерпывает всех случаев аккреции.
